title: Saved native-relay send intents are not reconciled automatically after the home host returns
outcome: When a remote runner's sends to native Central sessions fail during a home-host outage, the saved exact intents are redelivered automatically once the link is healthy again, without duplicates, so owners are not left blind.
acceptance: After a home-host outage ends and the relay link is healthy, a remote sender's saved native-relay send intents are delivered automatically with the same route, key and body, with no manual retry by the sender.
Automatic reconciliation creates no duplicate delivery of an intent already delivered.
A behavioural test with a simulated home outage shows saved intents delivered once after recovery and none lost.
